question: Among the following figures, how many have line symmetry: a line segment, an equilateral triangle, a parallelogram, a circle, an isosceles trapezoid, and a square? (Enter a number.)
solution:
A parallelogram in the general case does not have line symmetry. The other 5 figures all do.

If the listed parallelogram is assumed to be neither a rectangle nor a rhombus, the count is \(5\). If it is a rectangle or a rhombus, including a square, it also has line symmetry, and all six listed entries qualify, giving \(6\). The question gives no figure or condition that distinguishes these cases, so it has no unique numerical answer.
